id: title:dmarchuk:capture sent push notifications as message assets

observations.behavior: Adds MessageAssetsService dependency and its optional field to PushNotificationService constructor.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the push notification service to optionally record an asset row after delivery, without failing the invocation if capture fails.

observations.behavior: Adds a Set to track delivered platforms and records them when a push is successfully sent.
observations.posthog_connection: Collects delivery results to pass to the asset capture, distinguishing successful delivery from skipped or failed channels.

observations.behavior: Adds a best-effort asset capture block after successful delivery, with a try/catch and warning log, and does not propagate capture errors to the invocation result.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates the separation of concerns: delivery and capture are independent; a capture failure does not retry or fail the delivery, preserving the delivered notification while potentially missing an asset row.
